key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F17C
name: store_two_lookup_results
description: Calls one routine twice with the arguments 7 and 8, each time pointing at a different slot in the data area, and stores each returned word into its own fixed field of the data area.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F1B4
name: call_pair_when_flag_clear
description: Checks a 16-bit flag in the data area and, only when it is zero, calls the same routine twice in a row; otherwise it returns without doing anything.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F1D4
name: emit_slot_command_words
description: After one routine call and only when a 16-bit flag is nonzero, it resets a per-slot counter and writes a fixed sequence of words to the output, selecting one of two variants from the low word of its second argument. The words combine a value read through the first argument with a byte from the data area.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F1EC
name: start_audio_channel_one
description: Starts playback on audio channel 1 from a sample pointer and length held in a structure, writing the channel's start address, length, period and volume registers and enabling its DMA and interrupt bits. A flag in the structure selects one of two paths that differ only in the enable values written.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F248
name: start_audio_channel_zero
description: Starts playback on audio channel 0 from a sample pointer and length held in a structure, writing its start address, length, period and volume registers and enabling its DMA and interrupt bits.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F2A0
name: disable_selected_audio_channel
description: Chooses audio channel 0 or 1 from its argument, writes that channel's disable bits to the DMA and interrupt control registers, and then calls a library routine with the value 2.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F2BC
name: disable_audio_channel_zero
description: Writes the disable bits for audio channel 0 to the DMA and interrupt control registers, then calls a library routine with the value 2.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F2DA
name: disable_channels_and_set_volumes
description: Disables the first two audio channels, clears their control words, and then calls a routine twice with the arguments 8 and 7, passing values taken from the structure that the referenced volume registers receive.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F31A
name: set_voice_start_state
description: Sets a flag in the voice record and increments a shared counter. On the first call it stores a table pointer and the value 50 into the record; on later calls it sets two other fields to fixed values instead.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F33E
name: store_voice_table_pointer
description: Writes a pointer taken from the data area into one field of the voice record and the value 50 into the field after it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F34E
name: set_secondary_voice_start_state
description: Sets a flag in the voice record and increments a shared counter. On the first call it stores a table pointer and the value 50 into the record; on later calls it sets two other fields to fixed values instead.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F372
name: store_secondary_voice_table_pointer
description: Writes a pointer taken from the data area into one field of the voice record and the value 50 into the field after it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F5DA
name: lookup_masked_table_entry
description: Returns zero when the index exceeds 95; otherwise it scans a list of mask entries for one matching the record's flag word, then returns the value at the index in that entry's table. When the record's high flag bit is set, it also sets upper bits in the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F5F2
name: lookup_masked_entry_by_index
description: Scans the same mask list for an entry matching the record's flag word, then returns that entry's table value for the index passed in the data register. When the record's high flag bit is set, it also sets upper bits in the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F62A
name: init_trackdisk_disk_port
description: Its referenced text includes the trackdisk.device name and the messages about failing to create a port or access the drive, and it calls a library routine and four other routines. The decompiler could not produce pseudo-code, so the description is limited to these facts.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F74C
name: store_long_as_words
description: Writes the low and high words of its 32-bit argument to two consecutive output words, then writes a zero word after them.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F76A
name: write_argument_then_zero
description: Writes its argument to the output and then writes a zero value after it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F780
name: split_transfer_into_blocks
description: Splits a length into chunks of at most 512 units, limited by the remaining space, and makes a routine call for each chunk with advancing addresses. A final partial chunk is handled after the full blocks, and the shared position counters move by each chunk's size.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F89A
name: emit_indexed_block_sequence
description: Loops over a length in steps of 512, calling a routine on each step with the current block index and buffer position, then advances the position and index. The starting index is derived from a shared counter by multiplying by 22 and adding a shifted copy of it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F8C2
name: iterate_block_pairs_until_done
description: Repeats a routine call that takes two values from the structure, then advances the shared position by 512, the second pointer by 512 and the first pointer by one, and reduces the remaining length by 512 until none is left.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F8F8
name: dispatch_pending_transfer
description: When a shared value is zero and a second shared value is set, makes two routine calls, then calls a routine with a fixed constant and that second value. When the first shared value is nonzero, it passes that value to a routine instead.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F914
name: forward_pending_value_if_set
description: When a shared value is nonzero, makes two routine calls, then calls a routine with a fixed constant and that shared value. The same sequence appears in the preceding routine's second branch.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:F93E
name: align_and_seek_position
description: Rounds a file position up to the next 512-unit boundary and, when the rounded value differs, calls the DOS seek wrapper before storing the new position. It adds 2 units when the computed block index exceeds 879.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FA06
name: emit_block_transfer_words
description: Writes a fixed command word, the constant 512, the second argument and the first argument multiplied by 512 to the output, then calls a routine to finish the record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FA3A
name: emit_second_block_command
description: Writes a different fixed command word from the sibling routine, followed by 512, the second argument and the first argument multiplied by 512, then calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FA6C
name: wait_until_disk_unprotected
description: Repeatedly calls a routine with the value 15 and a fixed value, and while the result stays nonzero it calls a library routine with a constant before retrying. Its referenced text is the write-protected disk message.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FAA4
name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns, doing nothing else.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FAD0
name: prompt_for_battlechess_disk
description: Loops while a status value equals 29, and while a routine reports failure it shows the referenced Insert the BattleChess disk message through a library call, then pauses using a library call with the value 300 before retrying.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FB4C
name: check_disk_with_saved_block
description: Copies a 14-long block from a fixed area onto the stack, runs a sequence of routine and library calls on the disk, and then copies the saved block back to the fixed area. It returns 1 on one path and 0 on the other.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FC58
name: check_saves_disk_with_block
description: Copies a 14-long block from a fixed area onto the stack, makes a routine call using a shared counter plus 433 and a constant, and then restores the saved block. Its referenced text is ChessSaves, and it returns 1 on success and 0 otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FD34
name: copy_frame_block_then_succeed
description: Stores a shared value in the frame, copies 14 longs from the frame into a fixed area, makes one routine call and returns 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FD36
name: copy_frame_block_and_clear
description: Copies 14 longs from the frame into a fixed area, clears a shared value and returns 0.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FD52
name: copy_frame_block_return_one
description: Stores a shared value in the frame, copies 14 longs from the frame into a fixed area, makes one routine call and returns 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FD80
name: write_command_four_word
description: Writes the command word 32772 to the output and then calls a routine with a fixed value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FD9C
name: emit_reset_words_when_idle
description: When a shared value is zero, writes 9 and then 0 to the output and calls a library routine with a constant.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FDC8
name: set_status_to_minus_one
description: Sets a shared value to -1 and returns it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FDE0
name: read_block_into_buffer
description: Calls a library routine that reads a fixed-size block into a stack buffer, then calls a routine to process the bytes after the first three. It writes two bytes into the buffer and makes a final routine call with a 32-byte length.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FE24
name: prompt_for_saves_disk
description: Repeats a check until it succeeds. Each failed attempt makes a routine call and a library call that shows the referenced Insert the ChessSaves disk message, and after a retry it pauses with the value 300.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FE4E
name: delay_when_flag_set
description: When a 16-bit flag is set, calls a library routine with the value 300.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FE7E
name: clear_shared_status
description: Sets a shared value to zero and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FE8C
name: load_saved_games_list
description: Reads a 512-byte block into a stack buffer and, if that fails, shows the referenced No games saved text through a library call. Otherwise it sets a flag, runs an eight-entry loop that clears per-entry flags, and then processes port messages through library calls until an entry is chosen.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FEC2
name: run_load_selection_loop
description: Runs the same eight-entry message loop as the routine before it, with the referenced Load text. It waits for messages through library calls and returns the chosen entry, replying to each message as it arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FFAA
name: process_selection_messages
description: Handles one pass of the entry selection: a value below eight that repeats the previous selection is replied to and ends the pass, a new value is remembered, and the value 9 ends it. Otherwise it waits for the next message and replies to it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FFD0
name: continue_entry_selection_loop
description: Continues the entry selection loop. When a selection is already stored it redraws that entry's slot, otherwise it waits for messages and replies to each one, and it leaves when the value 9 is reached before clearing the busy flag and per-entry flags.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FFE4
name: wait_for_entry_choice
description: Waits on the port for the next message and replies to it, repeating until the value 9 is chosen or a stored selection exists. It then redraws the chosen entry and clears the busy flag and per-entry flags.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:FFE6
name: wait_until_entry_changes
description: Keeps waiting for messages while the current entry differs from the stored selection, replying to each and redrawing the selected slot. It then clears the busy flag and per-entry flags.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10006
name: poll_entry_until_matched
description: Repeats the message wait and reply while the stored selection differs from the current entry, redrawing the chosen slot each time. It then clears the busy flag and per-entry flags.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10012
name: poll_selection_messages_loop
description: Waits for port messages and, for each message of class 64, remembers the new entry, replies, or ends the selection pass. Other messages are only replied to, and when the value 9 is chosen it clears the busy flag and per-entry flags before returning.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10028
name: redraw_selected_entry_and_clear
description: Looks up the selected entry's slot from a table, computes its position from the entry index, and calls a routine and a library function to draw it. It re-checks a shared value and calls three library routines if it changed, then clears the busy flag and per-entry flags.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:100CE
name: enter_save_game_name
description: Shows the referenced Save prompt and reads a save-game name from port messages. Backspace removes the last character, printable keys append up to 14 characters, the bar cursor is toggled, and Return confirms the name for the selected slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1018E
name: run_save_name_entry_loop
description: Runs the same name entry loop as the Save routine, with its 15-byte buffer and cursor handling, and returns when the value 9 is chosen. It clears the busy flag and per-entry flags before returning.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1020A
name: continue_save_name_entry
description: Re-enters the save-name entry loop at its message handling step. It applies backspace, Return and printable characters to the name buffer and redraws the entry when the selection changes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1023E
name: restart_save_name_entry
description: Resets the entered name length to zero and then runs the save-name message loop, handling printable characters and Return the same way the Save routine does.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10246
name: handle_name_entry_keys
description: Adds a typed character to the save-name buffer up to 14 characters, and on Return draws the finished name into the selected slot. It then returns to the message loop to read the next message.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1028C
name: resume_save_name_message_loop
description: Re-enters the save-name message loop from its top, redrawing the selected slot and the cursor on each pass. It handles characters, backspace and Return the same way the name entry routine does.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1028E
name: add_typed_character_to_name
description: Adds a typed character to the save-name buffer up to 14 characters, then keeps reading port messages and handling Return, backspace and selection changes as the name entry routine does.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:102C8
name: toggle_name_cursor_and_poll
description: Toggles the bar cursor after the entered name and then reads port messages, handling Return, backspace and typed characters for the save-name buffer as the name entry routine does.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:102F6
name: draw_name_cursor_and_poll
description: Draws the bar cursor at the end of the entered name, then reads port messages and handles Return, backspace and typed characters for the save-name buffer, limited to 14 characters.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10320
name: reset_name_entry_and_poll
description: Clears the entered-name state for the save-name buffer and then reads port messages, redrawing the entry and handling Return, backspace and typed characters as the name entry routine does.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10328
name: poll_name_entry_selection
description: Handles a slot selection while the save-name entry is active, redrawing the chosen slot and the cursor, then reads port messages and handles Return, backspace and typed characters.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1034E
name: finish_name_entry_and_draw
description: Completes a save-name entry by clearing the buffer and drawing the entered name into the selected slot through library calls, then returns to the message loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10390
name: run_name_entry_message_loop
description: Reads port messages in a loop, redrawing the selected slot and the cursor on each pass, and handles Return, backspace and typed characters for the save-name buffer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10394
name: select_entry_and_poll_messages
description: Selects the slot index from the entry table, redraws the selected entry and then reads port messages, handling Return, backspace and typed characters for the name buffer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:103DE
name: finish_entry_draw_and_return
description: Clears the pending entry state when the name buffer is set, draws the entry name through library calls and returns to the caller.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:103FC
name: select_slot_then_poll
description: Handles a change of slot during name entry by redrawing the previously selected slot, drawing the new one, and then reading port messages in a loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1042C
name: handle_name_editing_keys
description: Dispatches port message classes for name editing: a class of 32 clears the entry flag, class 64 changes the selected slot, and raw keys handle backspace, Return and typed characters limited to 14 characters. Another class toggles the cursor between a bar and a space.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10462
name: draw_entry_and_wait_messages
description: Draws the entered name into its slot and then waits on port messages in a loop, redrawing the cursor and handling Return, backspace and typed characters until a slot is chosen.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:104EC
name: forward_to_routine_stub
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:104F8
name: fill_and_mark_buffer_end
description: Clears a buffer through a library call, passes it to a routine with the second argument, and then writes a space at the position reported by a length routine. It returns that position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10540
name: is_printable_ascii_char
description: Returns 1 when the low word of its argument lies between 32 and 126 inclusive, and 0 otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1055E
name: compact_saved_slot_names
description: Clears an 8-entry name buffer through a library call, then copies each non-empty slot name from the entry table into consecutive buffer entries and records the slot number at the end of each. It stores the number of names copied.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1057E
name: clear_and_copy_slot_names
description: Sets the marker bytes of an 8-entry name buffer to zero and 255, then copies each non-empty slot name into consecutive buffer entries, recording each slot number, and stores the number of names copied.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1059A
name: copy_slot_names_into_buffer
description: Copies each non-empty slot name from the entry table into consecutive buffer entries, recording each slot number at the end of its entry, and stores the count of names copied without clearing the buffer first.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:105F4
name: draw_saved_game_list
description: Draws the referenced Load title and the dashed rule, then draws eight numbered slot names from the buffer through library calls. It then draws the entry count and a highlighted label for the selected row.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1074C
name: draw_two_panel_rectangles
description: Sets a graphics attribute through a library call and draws two rectangles: one at the origin measuring 208 by 89, and one with corners at 51 and 51 and end points at 267 and 148.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1079E
name: draw_menu_labels
description: Sets a drawing colour through a library call, draws two fixed labels from the data area, draws a third label only when the flag argument is nonzero, and then draws a final label.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10806
name: draw_cancel_done_buttons
description: Draws the referenced Cancel and Done button labels through library calls. The flag argument decides whether a four-byte item is drawn before the six-byte one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:108A2
name: draw_rectangle_outline
description: Sets a colour through a library call using the first two coordinates, then builds a closed five-point outline from four box corners and draws it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1091A
name: open_device_or_report_failure
description: Opens a library device under a stored name, keeps the returned handle, and on failure shows the referenced unable to open message through a library call. It returns whether the handle is nonzero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10948
name: return_constant_success
description: Returns 1 without doing any other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10966
name: close_device_handle_if_open
description: When a stored handle is set, closes it through a library call, makes a second library call with fixed values, clears the handle and then calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1099C
name: read_block_from_named_file
description: Builds a file name in a 32-byte buffer and opens it for reading. When the open succeeds it reads 512 bytes into the destination and closes the file; when it fails it calls a library routine on the destination with a fixed constant. It returns whether the open succeeded.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:109D6
name: call_library_then_succeed
description: Calls a library routine, then one other routine, and returns 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:109F4
name: write_block_to_named_file
description: Builds a file name in a 32-byte buffer, calls a routine first when a 16-bit flag is zero, then opens the file for writing. On success it writes 512 bytes from the source and closes the file. It returns whether the open succeeded.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10A26
name: run_two_steps_then_succeed
description: Calls two other routines in sequence and returns 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10A44
name: clear_buffer_and_check_saves
description: Clears the first byte of a buffer, then calls a routine with the buffer and a shared value, first calling a second routine when a 16-bit flag is zero. Its referenced text includes the ChessSaves name.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10A90
name: build_request_block_and_call
description: Initialises a 22-byte request block by zeroing its leading fields, setting a fixed type byte and storing the caller's two parameters into it. It then passes the block and the second argument to a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10AE4
name: init_buffer_pointers_and_words
description: Calls a routine to set up a structure, points two of its fields at the same buffer, and writes three fixed words to the output.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10B26
name: send_bytes_over_serial
description: Sends a zero-terminated-length run of bytes one at a time to the serial data register, waiting until the transmit-ready bit is set before each byte. The run length is the second argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10B4A
name: send_counted_serial_bytes
description: Sends a counted run of bytes through the serial data register, waiting for the transmit-ready bit before each byte and stopping when the count reaches zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10B5E
name: empty_stub_routine
description: Does nothing and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10B66
name: read_bytes_from_receive_buffer
description: Copies bytes one at a time from a circular receive buffer into the destination, waiting between bytes with repeated timer calls up to a time limit. It returns 0 when the requested count is filled and -1 when the wait times out.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10BB0
name: read_bytes_with_deadline
description: Copies bytes from the circular receive buffer until the requested count is reached, using the same timer-based wait for each byte. It returns -1 if the time limit passes first and 0 when the count is complete.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10BDE
name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Returns -1 without doing any other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10BE8
name: read_bytes_timed_from_buffer
description: Copies bytes from the circular receive buffer into the destination, waiting with timer calls before each byte. It returns 0 when the requested count is filled and -1 if a wait times out.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10BEA
name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns 0 without doing any other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10BEE
name: clear_receive_buffer_read_index
description: Sets the receive buffer's read position equal to its write position, discarding any received bytes that have not been read.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10BFC
name: count_pending_receive_bytes
description: Returns how many bytes are waiting in a 128-byte circular receive buffer, by subtracting the read position from the write position and wrapping around the end when needed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10C1E
name: compute_pending_byte_count
description: Computes the number of bytes waiting in the 128-byte circular receive buffer from a frame value and the read position, stores the result in the frame and returns it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10C36
name: write_fixed_word_and_call
description: Writes a fixed word to the output and then calls a routine with the constant 11 and a stored value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10C54
name: append_byte_to_ring_buffer
description: Stores the low byte of a value at the write position of a 128-byte ring buffer, advances that position, and wraps it back to the start when it passes the end. It also writes a fixed word into the record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10C7E
name: send_packet_with_checksum_retries
description: Computes a checksum over the packet bytes into a two-byte field, then sends the packet and checksum through a library routine. Each reply is checked: a timeout sends a fixed four-byte marker, a reply of -92 resends the packet, and a reply of -91 accepts it. After five attempts it shows a failure message.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10CAC
name: send_checksum_packet_with_retries
description: Accumulates a checksum over the packet into a stack field, sends the packet and checksum through a library routine, and then applies the same reply rules as the neighbouring packet sender. It gives up after five attempts.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10D08
name: await_packet_reply_with_retries
description: Waits for a reply after sending a packet: a reply of -92 resends the packet, -91 accepts it, and a timeout sends a fixed four-byte marker. Five attempts end with a failure message shown through a library call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10D2C
name: await_send_ack_with_retries
description: Handles replies to a send using the same accept and resend codes as its neighbours, and resends a timeout marker. After five attempts it shows the failure message. Its referenced text begins with Sending at the same time.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10D4C
name: retry_until_opponent_responds
description: Retries a send up to five times, resending the packet and a fixed marker on timeouts and on replies of -92. When the attempts run out it shows the referenced Opponent not responding message through a library call. Other reply codes stop the attempt with an error message.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10DBA
name: decode_received_packet
description: Checks an incoming packet's header nibble and its length limit of 40, verifies a character checksum over its bytes, and then acts on the packet type. Type 166 sends a fixed reply marker, type 170 sets a flag, and other types are rejected. It returns whether the packet was accepted.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10E42
name: scan_packets_for_header_match
description: Scans incoming bytes for a packet whose next two bytes match the expected pair, then handles that packet type with the same reply rules as the packet decoder. It returns 0 when a packet is rejected and -1 when the scan runs out of data.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10E72
name: receive_line_and_match_command
description: Waits for incoming data and reads it into a line buffer that ends at a carriage return. It checks whether the line is the three-character command ATE and reports an error through a library call otherwise. It returns -1 when no data arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10E7A
name: send_status_then_receive_line
description: Sends one of two four-byte status strings, chosen by a flag, then runs the same line-receiving loop. It returns -1 when no data arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10E88
name: send_fixed_status_then_receive
description: Sends a fixed four-byte status string and then runs the line-receiving loop, returning -1 when no data arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10EA2
name: return_false_stub
description: Returns 0 without doing any other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10EAC
name: dispatch_message_code_then_receive
description: Handles a message code: code 166 sends a status string chosen by a flag, code 170 sets a flag, and any other code returns 0. It then runs the line-receiving loop and returns -1 when no data arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10EBA
name: receive_line_loop_entry
description: Enters the line-receiving loop directly. It waits for incoming data, reads it into a line buffer that ends at a carriage return, and returns -1 when no data arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10EC6
name: receive_packet_with_retry_flag
description: Sets a retry flag and then receives incoming bytes, handling line text and packet frames whose header nibble marks a packet of under 40 bytes. It returns -1 when no data arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10ED2
name: receive_packet_frame_loop
description: Receives incoming line text and packet frames in a loop, accepting frames whose length is at most 39 and writing a space and a zero into the frame field. It returns -1 when no data arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10EDA
name: receive_packet_frame_once
description: Reads one incoming line or packet frame, validating the header and checksum as the neighbouring receivers do. It returns -1 when no data arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10F12
name: receive_packet_and_reply
description: Clears the destination byte, checks the command text, and then receives packets. A frame with header nibble 10 and under 40 bytes is checksum-verified, and a matching checksum is answered with a fixed status string chosen by a flag, while the other packet code sets a flag. It returns -1 when no data arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10F4C
name: send_status_and_receive_packet
description: Sends a status string, then receives and verifies packet frames as the neighbouring receiver does, answering accepted frames with a status string or setting a flag. It returns -1 when no data arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10F62
name: send_link_status_command
description: When either of two stored link state values equals 2, builds a two-byte command of 161 and 37, sends it with a 38-byte payload buffer, and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10FA6
name: send_status_packet_from_fields
description: Builds a four-byte packet with header 162 and length 6, copies two bytes taken from fields of the argument structure into it, and sends it through a library routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:10FEA
name: send_short_control_packet
description: Sends a two-byte control packet with header 169 and length 5 through a library routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1101E
name: send_status_and_clear_flag
description: Sends the fixed four-byte status string through a library routine and then clears a stored flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:11040
name: fill_buffer_with_descending_bytes
description: Writes consecutive bytes into the buffer, counting down from the count argument minus one to zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:11054
name: next_random_fifteen_bit_value
description: Calls a library routine, adds 12345 to its result to update a stored seed, and returns the upper word of the seed with its top bit cleared, giving a 15-bit value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:11088
name: set_random_seed_high_word
description: Stores the upper word of its argument as the seed value used by the random number routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1109A
name: uppercase_ascii_letter
description: Returns its character argument converted to uppercase when it is a lowercase letter, and otherwise returns it unchanged.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:110B2
name: lowercase_ascii_letter
description: Returns its character argument converted to lowercase when it is an uppercase letter, and otherwise returns it unchanged.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:110CA
name: clear_state_and_start_library
description: Clears a block of about 34,000 bytes of program state, records the stack frame and the library base, and calls a library routine. A zero result leads to a second library call, and any other result leads to a routine call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1113C
name: return_without_action
description: Does nothing and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:11144
name: allocate_and_init_table_entry
description: Allocates a table of six-byte entries sized from a stored count, and when that succeeds it initialises its fields and writes the four-character tag MANX into a stored structure. It then makes library calls with the stored values, and on allocation failure it calls a routine with zeros and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1127A
name: tokenize_quoted_text_line
description: Splits a line of text into tokens separated by spaces, tabs or line breaks, keeping quoted strings together with doubled quotes as escapes, and copies each token into a buffer. It sets a status field once a token has been parsed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1127C
name: parse_script_text_arguments
description: Allocates a buffer and fills it from a stored record, then splits the text into arguments, keeping quoted strings together with doubled-quote escapes and storing the token list for later use. It also sets a status field once parsing has started.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1142E
name: copy_string_with_zero_padding
description: Copies a zero-terminated string into a destination up to a given length, filling the rest of the destination with zeros, and returns the destination.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:11450
name: move_bytes_handling_overlap
description: Copies a block of bytes of a given length from one place to another, copying backwards when the regions overlap so the source is not corrupted. It does nothing when the source and destination are the same.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1147A
name: append_string_bounded_length
description: Appends a zero-terminated source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most about 32,000 characters and terminating the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:11480
name: append_string_up_to_limit
description: Appends up to a given number of characters from a source string to the end of a destination string and terminates the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:114A4
name: compare_strings_ordered
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings character by character and returns 0 when they are equal, -1 when the first sorts before the second, and 1 otherwise. The scan stops after about 32,000 characters.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:114D4
name: copy_zero_terminated_string
description: Copies a zero-terminated string into a destination, including its terminator, and returns the destination.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:114E4
name: multiply_two_32bit_values
description: Multiplies two 32-bit unsigned values taken from the data registers using 16-bit partial products, and returns the 64-bit result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:11508
name: open_named_resource_file
description: Looks up a named resource through library calls and opens the file it names in read mode. It stores the file handle and a second value in the given record, then closes the lookup handle and clears the stored handle that was set earlier.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:115BA
name: read_timer_ticks_value
description: Opens a timer device through library calls and, if that fails, makes library calls to clean up. It then reads the current tick count, adds the elapsed value, closes the device and returns the total, also storing it in the optional result pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:115BC
name: read_timer_ticks_or_error
description: Opens a timer device through library calls, reads the current tick count, and adds the elapsed value. Its referenced text is the timer is not available message, which is shown when the device cannot be opened. The total is returned and stored in the optional result pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:11672
name: multiply_signed_long_values
description: Computes the signed product of two 32-bit values from the data registers by working on their absolute values, multiplying them unsigned, and applying the combined sign to the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1169A
name: apply_sign_to_division_result
description: Calls a helper routine and negates its result when the first data register holds a negative value, returning the result in the data registers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:116B4
name: forward_unsigned_division_pair
description: Calls one helper routine and returns its 64-bit result pair unchanged in the data registers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:116C0
name: forward_call_wrapper_void
description: Calls one other routine and returns, with no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:116CA
name: divide_unsigned_long_values
description: Divides one 32-bit unsigned value by another, using 16-bit division when the divisor fits in 16 bits and a shift-and-subtract loop otherwise. It returns the quotient and the remainder.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:116F4
name: shift_subtract_divide_step
description: Runs a fixed 16-step shift-and-subtract division of a 32-bit dividend by the swapped divisor, leaving the partial result in the registers. It returns nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1171A
name: measure_string_length
description: Returns the number of characters before the zero terminator of a string.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1172C
name: run_optional_hook_then_call
description: Calls an optional hook routine when its stored pointer is set, then calls another routine and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1174A
name: release_resources_and_handles
description: Releases the per-entry records and the buffers and handles it has stored, calling each release routine only when its pointer is set. It returns the stored result value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:11764
name: release_resources_via_supervisor
description: Releases the per-entry records and the stored buffers and handles like its neighbour, and calls the exec Supervisor function through a library call before returning the stored result value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:117E4
name: finish_stored_entry_or_table
description: Releases the stored entry when its first slot is empty, or otherwise makes two routine calls that release a second slot and its size field. It then returns the stored result value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1181A
name: call_routines_with_stored_value
description: Calls one routine, then calls a second routine with the value stored in the record, and returns the stored result value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:11832
name: empty_void_stub
description: Does nothing and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:11838
name: release_indexed_table_entry
description: Releases the table entry at the given index when it is in range and in use, calling a release routine on its stored value unless a flag marks it as shared. It then clears the entry and returns 0; an out-of-range or empty entry sets an error code and returns -1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1186E
name: release_entry_value_if_owned
description: Clears a stored entry, first calling a release routine on its value unless a flag marks it as shared, and returns 0.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:11884
name: invoke_dispatch_table_slot_one
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer held in the stored dispatch table, at one fixed slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:11888
name: close_file_via_dispatch
description: Calls the dos Close function through the stored dispatch table pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:11894
name: invoke_dispatch_table_slot_two
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer in the stored dispatch table, at a second fixed slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:118A0
name: pause_via_dispatch_delay
description: Calls the dos Delay function through the stored dispatch table pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:118AC
